connector.name: MCP by fluf.io
connector.registryDescription: Manage a FLUF resale account from an AI agent: inventory, crosslisting and unified orders.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package fluf-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.fluf, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FLUF_API_TOKEN
env.description: Personal access token from https://fluf.io/connect/settings (Developer tab). Requires an active FLUF plan.

env.name: FLUF_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API host. Defaults to https://fluf.io.
